# AA Medellín Map

> Independent, daily-updated directory of Alcoholics Anonymous meetings in Medellín, Colombia: 105 Spanish-language groups (from AA Colombia's directory, aacolombia.org) and 9 English-speaking meetings (from aamedellin.org and local listings). Not affiliated with AA.

Last updated: 2026-10-19

- [English-speaking AA meetings in Medellín](https://www.aamedellinmap.org/en/): map, weekly schedule, addresses and contacts
- [Reuniones de AA en Medellín (español)](https://www.aamedellinmap.org/): all groups with map and filters
- [Raw data (JSON)](https://www.aamedellinmap.org/data.json)
